=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2757-2769 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment above `if is_truthy "${FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED:-true}"` still lists "its head is the validated SHA" as a retry precondition, but a moved head now resumes in `revalidate` mode (lines 11220-11226: fmar_revalidate=true, label ai:validating).
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the comment contradicts the function header (lines 11105-11121) and the agents.d fragment, so operators triaging incidents may wrongly expect a moved head to stay parked; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- README.md:323, 3424-3427 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED` row (line 323) and validation-gate item 14 (line ~3427) list "its head is the validated SHA (`validation_last_passed_sha`)" / "head still the validated SHA" as a precondition, then say in the next sentence that a moved head is re-validated and merged.
  WHY: Each paragraph contradicts itself and the shipped behaviour, where head equality only picks merge mode over revalidate mode (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11223-11225). This misleads operators deciding whether to set `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED=false`. openai_gpt-6-luna also cites scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2767-2768. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11320-11324 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When post_state_comment fails in maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion, the function only logs a ::warning:: and returns 0. The caller (lines 29822-29839) then dispatches validation or calls mark_validation_complete, even though the per-head ledger `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` was never durably persisted.
  WHY: The reader falls back to the last persisted state (lines 3788-3790), so the next tick can resume the same head again. This breaks issue #9320's one-retry-per-head guarantee and, according to z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, can loop every tick with duplicate tracking comments and label churn. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, luna, glm) vs NIT (minimax). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this finding: the state comment is re-written right after the resume (lines 16497, 17649/17675/17711), and elsewhere the poller tolerates post_state_comment failures with `|| true`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11290 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The ledger update truncates final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas to the last 20 entries (`.[-20:]`).
  WHY: After 20 distinct heads, an earlier retried SHA is evicted. If the head cycles back to it, the guard at line 11216 allows another retry, breaking one-try-per-head. minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same issue as a NIT TASK_GAP; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as an unreachable scenario.
- (Regression failure context):Pre-push test gate | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR is blamed for regression failures in tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py and shellcheck.
  WHY: According to google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, these failures point to broken repository invariants or contract guards that must be fixed before merge. This is disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say the suites cover files this PR does not touch and that CI on the head shows failed_count=0. minimax_minimax-m3 noted the disagreement as an unresolved observation outside its lens findings.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry" and "no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion (the jq filter that updates final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas, line 11290)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The ledger update ends with `| .[-20:]` (`final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas = ... | .[-20:]`, line 11290), so an earlier retried SHA is evicted once there have been more than 20 resumed heads. If the head returns to that SHA (force-push, rewind or duplicated commit), the guard `(.final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas // []) | index($h) != null` (line 11216) no longer blocks another retry. Both reviewers rated it NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to carry this gap forward as unreachable.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime. The comment contradicts the function header (lines 11105-11121) and the agents.d fragment, so an operator would expect a moved head to stay parked.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 11320-11324 (caller at lines 29830-29838) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When post_state_comment fails, the function warns and returns 0, and the caller dispatches validation or calls mark_validation_complete while the ledger exists only in the local STATE_FILE.
  WHY: If persistence stays unavailable for one tick, the guard at line ~11216 lets the same head be retried again, breaking issue #9320 item 4. The code does not fail closed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry" and "no further automatic retry happens until the PR's head changes."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the ledger update inside maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion (jq filter applied to final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas around line ~11279)
  Evidence of absence: The `| .[-20:]` truncation evicts older retried SHAs. If the head returns to an evicted SHA, the guard `(.final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas // []) | index($h) != null` no longer recognises it.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  WHY: A later poll can reload state without this head in final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas and resume it again, breaking one-retry-per-head.
